_doc: Self-hosted model tier (over-limit = queue, KV admission on active state), partly-open MMPP session arrivals with human think time, a mixed society (coding / function-calling / research). hold_model_during_tool=True is the pinned-request configuration (server-side tools), reported separately. Used for E2-E4.

generator._doc: recipe_temperature sharpens (<1) or flattens (>1) every transition / tools_per_chat / tool_kind row as p^(1/T) renormalised (A7); 1.0 = the seeded rows. think_snr in [0,1] = share of log think-time variance explained by the observable state (recipe, phase before final, request bucket); 0 = i.i.d. seeds (B7); think_state_seed fixes the state->offset table of the society (same across run seeds); tool_tail_scale multiplies the log-sd of every tool-duration lognormal (medians kept); p_parallel_scale multiplies every recipe's p_parallel (clipped to 1). content_snr in [0,1] = probability that a step's content cue (tool skeleton class, prompt output/tool-count class, response plan phase) is the true class rather than uniform noise; the cue is drawn from its own stream so spans are identical at any value (PREDICTOR_DESIGN §8).

reaction._doc: SDK retries come first (policy.sdk_retries); only then the agent replans or aborts. PRIOR.

policy._doc: sdk_retries/backoff = Anthropic/OpenAI SDK defaults (2 retries, 0.5-8 s, jittered); jitter=false reproduces the herd; queue = fifo | vtfq (virtual-time fair queuing on realised memory-centric cost, a fixed rule); tau / h are the lease controller's two knobs (quantile, horizon seconds) needs = the Needs controller (policy.type=needs): model = pre-trained predictor (data/models/*.npz, '' = learn online from scratch), learn/replay = online learning and replay steps per label; jev = the System One channel (ext.jev): enabled, model file ('' = untrained), rpm/concurrency/background_load/latency.
